Starting Sept 2026 – Apr 2027
Purdue University · MARS Lab
Research Internship — Tactile Sensing & Robot Manipulation
Completed a research internship under Professor Yu She and mentor Dr. Sheeraz Athar. Contributed to the integration and validation of multimodal tactile sensing hardware — embedded electronics, miniature cameras, and LED illumination — and to the build, wiring, and in-water testing of a BlueROV2 Heavy underwater platform, including diagnosing and correcting a thruster polarity issue found during pool trials. Designed a tactile sensing gripper and its rotation mechanism in Onshape CAD, iterating from initial concept through physical assembly.
June 2026 – August 2026
Purdue University · TRACE Lab
Research Assistantship — Autonomous Mobility & Digital Twins
Supporting digital twin development for autonomous public transportation research under Professor Yan Gu. Evaluating CAD models to support rapid development of full-scale transit bus interior designs.
July 2026 – Present
UNC Chapel Hill · Vaziri Lab
Remote Research Internship
Computational oncology research on DNA Damage Response (DDR) profiling in Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma. Configured R-based bioinformatics environment, performed genomic data preprocessing, and applied K-means clustering to stratify patients by molecular signatures.
